chapters.label: Near post, live
chapters.text: Lusail, World Cup 2022. Portugal lead Switzerland two-nil. Diogo Dalot zips down the right... and drives it low to the near post. Ramos darts across... flicks it in, first time! Goal!

chapters.label: Keep moving
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. See Ramos keep moving? He gets in front of his defender, at the near post.

chapters.label: One touch
chapters.text: From behind the goal: one touch, and it squeezes through the keeper's legs. Portugal lead three-nil!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: keep moving in the box. When you keep moving, your defender can't settle next to you. Then hit it first time!
